title: A language-theoretic approach to study the density of subsets in free groups
summary: In this paper, we study the density of subsets of nonabelian free groups using relative densities of languages. We start by proving some basic properties about the density of a language $L_1$ relative to another language $L_2$ containing $L_1$. We then focus on the case where $L_2$ is the language of freely reduced words over an alphabet and prove an analogue of the Infinite Monkey Theorem for this language.
